name: Absorption Reversal
thesis: Heavy volume with heavy aggressor buying that fails to produce a new high means a large passive seller is absorbing every bid. The failure of aggressive buying to move price is the clearest evidence of size on the other side.
invalidation: Retire if worst-symbol out-of-sample profit factor stays below 1.0 over 30 trades, or if the mechanism's driving series stops being published.
entry_short: volume > 2.0 * sma_of(volume, 96) and taker_buy_frac > 0.6 and close < donchian_hi(96)
